description.value: Da Silva Vineyards is a boutique family-owned winery on the Naramata Bench just north of Penticton, rooted in a Portuguese farming heritage brought to the South Okanagan in 1955. The property features an intimate seated tasting room where a winemaker guides small groups through terroir-driven wines drawn from six estate vineyards. An on-site restaurant, The Kitchen, offers unconventional fine dining with Mexican and Portuguese-inspired tapas, making it a potential rest-and-refuel destination for cyclists touring the Naramata Bench.

address.value: 375 Upper Bench Road North, Penticton, BC V2A 8T2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully corroborates OSM contact details: phone 1 (800) 851-0903, address 375 Upper Bench Road North Penticton BC V2A 8T2, and website URL all match. The site confirms the business is open (tasting room reopened March 6 2026) and describes a tasting room plus on-site restaurant (The Kitchen). No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, water refill, washrooms—are mentioned anywhere in the website text, so all are null.
concerns: The Kitchen restaurant is seasonal; the website notes it was closed as of October 11 2025 and implies a 2026 reopening, so food service may not always be available.
No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information found on the website; these required criteria remain unconfirmed and should be verified on-site or by direct contact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed operating winery with an on-site restaurant on the Naramata Bench, a well-travelled cycling corridor north of Penticton; a natural stop for touring cyclists despite the absence of confirmed cycle-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website postal code (V2A 8T2) was added to the OSM address, which listed only the street. Tasting room is 19+ and limited to groups of six; reservations strongly recommended.
